text: The County seeks actuarial services for its self-insurance plan, including an annual workers’ compensation valuation and three-year forecasts

citations.text: The County of Ulster is currently seeking proposals for actuarial services for the Ulster County Self-Insurance Plan which includes County Government, local municipalities, school districts, and volunteer fire fighters.
The County is seeking a qualified Actuary Firm to provide an annual actuarial valuation of the County’s self-insured workers compensation program.

The County is asking for an estimate of the liability annually for a three-year period ending December 31, 2026, 2027, and 2028 with two optional one-year renewals for years ending December 31, 2029 and 2030.
Each year, the awarded vendor will produce a report containing a three-year forecast.

citations.text: By submitting a proposal, the Responder assents to the procedure outlined in this paragraph and shall have no claim against Ulster County on account of actions taken under such procedure.
